roles.name: Contract Risk Analyst
roles.blurb: Scores the risk of every operations and maintenance contract on one scorecard, watches every contract each morning, says what moved and why, writes a mitigation plan for each site, and answers questions about the portfolio.

areas.name: Non-negotiable Contract Terms
areas.what: Contract terms the company should never accept, such as uncapped liability.
tasks: Legal review of the non-negotiable terms

areas.name: Commercial Terms
areas.what: Terms and conditions that make the contract harder or costlier to run.
tasks: Fixed-price exposure on energy, chemicals and biosolids

areas.name: Permit Compliance
areas.what: Whether the plant meets its permits. Three-year average.
tasks: Operators using the plant data system

areas.name: Workforce
areas.what: Whether the site has enough qualified people.

areas.name: Client Satisfaction
areas.what: How the client feels about us.
tasks: Client survey score for the site
Client survey score for the region

areas.name: Community Standing
areas.what: How residents and local media see the operation.

areas.name: State Legal Climate
areas.what: How costly the state is for lawsuits.
tasks: Lawsuit cost ranking of the state

areas.name: Asset Condition and Complexity
areas.what: The condition and complexity of the assets we run.
tasks: Year of the last major upgrade
Maintenance hours logged to work orders
Client capital plan, next five years

areas.name: Neighbors
areas.what: How many homes sit near the plant.

areas.name: Water Quality and Contaminants
areas.what: The water coming in, and the contaminants new rules target.

areas.name: Financial Performance
areas.what: How the contract is doing commercially. Money problems tend to show before the others.

areas.name: Client and Political Environment
areas.what: The people and the politics on the client side, where most renewals are decided.
tasks: Talk of in-house operation or a re-bid

areas.name: Climate and Operational Resilience
areas.what: Sudden events that no monthly figure predicts.

areas.name: What is at stake
areas.what: How much a loss would matter and how soon. Kept beside the risk score, not inside it.
tasks: Options left at the end of the term

metrics.name: Legal review of the non-negotiable terms
metrics.def: Read clause by clause; a draft for Legal to confirm
metrics.threshold: Misses the core terms and other important ones

metrics.name: Prevailing wage state
metrics.def: State of the plant against the eight listed states
metrics.threshold: In CA, MA, NY, IL, WA, NJ, CT or OR

metrics.name: Days sales outstanding
metrics.def: Average receivables over revenue, times the days in the period

metrics.name: Biosolids handling in scope
metrics.def: Scope read from the contract and checked against the master list

metrics.name: Unionized workforce
metrics.def: Bargaining unit on the site roster

metrics.name: Water distribution network in scope
metrics.def: Scope read from the contract and checked against the master list

metrics.name: Sewer collection network in scope
metrics.def: Scope read from the contract and checked against the master list

metrics.name: Lost-time injuries
metrics.def: Lost time injuries per 200,000 hours, rolling twelve months

metrics.name: Recordable injuries
metrics.def: Recordable injuries per 200,000 hours, rolling twelve months

metrics.name: Safety observations per employee
metrics.def: Near misses and safety observations submitted this year, per employee

metrics.name: Days within permit limits
metrics.def: Share of permit days met, by site, three-year average

metrics.name: Required samples missed
metrics.def: Required samples with no result by the due date, this year

metrics.name: Notices of violation
metrics.def: Each notice read; the public record catches any not filed

metrics.name: Operators using the plant data system
metrics.def: Operator logins per working day, last 90 days

metrics.name: Positions open more than 60 days
metrics.def: Requisitions open longer than 60 days, by site
metrics.threshold: One or more open over 60 days

metrics.name: Licensed operators against the contract
metrics.def: The licence level the contract requires against the licences on the roster
metrics.threshold: Required: no holder and no backup

metrics.name: Staff retention
metrics.def: Staff at the start of the year still on the roster

metrics.name: Overtime share of payroll
metrics.def: Overtime dollars over payroll dollars, last 13 weeks

metrics.name: Client survey score for the site
metrics.def: The client's latest answer for the site

metrics.name: Client survey score for the region
metrics.def: Revenue-weighted score across the region

metrics.name: Client survey trend, five years
metrics.def: Slope of the site score over five surveys

metrics.name: Odor complaints
metrics.def: Odor complaints logged this year; mail to the site is read for ones not logged

metrics.name: Local media coverage: % negative
metrics.def: Every local media report of the last twelve months that names the plant or the operator is read and marked negative, neutral or positive. The figure is the negative reports divided by the total number of reports

metrics.name: Local media coverage: % positive
metrics.def: The same media reports. The figure is the positive reports divided by the total number of reports

metrics.name: Community investment per year
metrics.def: Sponsorships, outings and scholarships by cost centre

metrics.name: Community investment trend, five years
metrics.def: Slope of the annual spend over five years

metrics.name: Lawsuit cost ranking of the state
metrics.def: The 2026 edition, read from the page; checked again when a new edition is posted

metrics.name: Lawsuits filed
metrics.def: Open and closed matters by site; public dockets catch suits not yet on the list
metrics.threshold: High dollar enforcement or personal injury claims, active or in the last 3 years

metrics.name: Consent orders
metrics.def: Each order read for who it binds: the client, the operator or both

metrics.name: Lawsuits threatened
metrics.def: Demand letters, pre-suit notices and claim correspondence, read as they arrive
metrics.threshold: Demand letters or pre-suit notices received

metrics.name: Services covered by the contract
metrics.def: Counted from the scope clause: treatment, distribution, collection, biosolids, stormwater, reuse

metrics.name: Year of the last major upgrade
metrics.def: The last major process upgrade named in the reports

metrics.name: Maintenance hours logged to work orders
metrics.def: Share of maintenance labour hours booked to a work order

metrics.name: Planned maintenance done on time
metrics.def: Planned maintenance work orders closed on time, last 90 days

metrics.name: Client capital plan, next five years
metrics.def: Read from the adopted plan and the council budget

metrics.name: Homes within two miles
metrics.def: Residential parcels within 2 miles of the plant fence line; recounted when the county parcel file changes

metrics.name: Lead in drinking water
metrics.def: 90th percentile of the latest tap sampling round

metrics.name: PFAS in drinking water
metrics.def: Latest results against the federal limits, and whether treatment is planned
metrics.threshold: Exceeds the MCL; no planning under way

metrics.name: Nitrogen in effluent
metrics.def: Monthly average against the permit limit
metrics.threshold: Over 80% of the limit for 3 months or more

metrics.name: Copper in drinking water
metrics.def: 90th percentile of the latest tap sampling round

metrics.name: Suspended solids in effluent
metrics.def: Monthly average against the permit limit
metrics.threshold: Over 80% of the limit for 3 months or more

metrics.name: Phosphorus in effluent
metrics.def: Monthly average against the permit limit
metrics.threshold: Over 80% of the limit for 3 months or more

metrics.name: Fixed-price exposure on energy, chemicals and biosolids
metrics.def: Which costs the fee fixes and which pass through

metrics.name: Performance guarantees and penalty clauses
metrics.def: Guarantees, liquidated damages and their cap

metrics.name: Price escalation clause
metrics.def: The index, the cap and how often it applies

metrics.name: Sewer overflows (SSO and CSO)
metrics.def: Reported overflows, rolling twelve months

metrics.name: Permit renewal status
metrics.def: Permit number matched to the site; expiry date and draft limits

metrics.name: Site manager tenure
metrics.def: Start date of the project leader in the role

metrics.name: Key-person dependence
metrics.def: Holders of each licence the contract requires, and their hours

metrics.name: Corrective against preventive maintenance
metrics.def: Corrective hours over all maintenance hours, twelve months

metrics.name: Asset age
metrics.def: Weighted age of the critical assets

metrics.name: PFAS in biosolids and effluent
metrics.def: Lab results against the rules proposed or in force in the state

metrics.name: Rules on the way (nutrients, lead)
metrics.def: Rules that apply to the permit, with their dates
metrics.threshold: In effect, plant not yet upgraded

metrics.name: Margin against budget
metrics.def: Actual margin less budget margin, year to date

metrics.name: Margin trend, 24 months
metrics.def: Slope of monthly margin over 24 months

metrics.name: Cost overruns
metrics.def: Labour, chemicals, energy and repairs against plan

metrics.name: Unbilled or disputed change orders
metrics.def: Open change orders older than 60 days, over the annual fee

metrics.name: Penalties and liquidated damages paid
metrics.def: Penalty accounts by contract, three years

metrics.name: Change in key client contacts
metrics.def: New names and titles on the client side; introductions and hand-overs

metrics.name: Election or council turnover
metrics.def: Seats on the ballot for the body that owns the contract
metrics.threshold: Majority changed in the last 12 months

metrics.name: Talk of in-house operation or a re-bid
metrics.def: Agendas and minutes searched for the contract, in-house operation and procurement
metrics.threshold: On a public agenda, or an adviser hired

metrics.name: Client financial health
metrics.def: Rating, outlook and whether the rate increase passed

metrics.name: The contract in public meetings
metrics.def: Mentions of the operator or the plant, twelve months

metrics.name: Client escalations
metrics.def: Complaints from client staff that went above the project leader
metrics.threshold: One open with the client's director or above

metrics.name: Competitor nearby
metrics.def: Who operates the neighbouring plants
metrics.threshold: Two or more in the same county

metrics.name: Recent competitor wins
metrics.def: Awards in the region, and who presented to which board
metrics.threshold: A competitor has presented to this client

metrics.name: Price pressure
metrics.def: Requests for benchmarks, price reviews and budget cuts
metrics.threshold: Client said in writing that we cost too much

metrics.name: Flood and extreme weather exposure
metrics.def: The plant address against the flood zone and the storm record
metrics.threshold: In the 100-year zone, flooded in the last 10 years

metrics.name: Drought and source water
metrics.def: The county of the source, weekly

metrics.name: Cybersecurity of plant controls
metrics.def: The latest assessment and its open findings

metrics.name: Emergency response readiness
metrics.def: Date of the plan and of the last drill

metrics.name: Annual contract revenue
metrics.def: Fee billed, last twelve months

metrics.name: Margin contribution
metrics.def: Margin in dollars, last twelve months

metrics.name: Months to renewal or end
metrics.def: End date of the current term

metrics.name: Options left at the end of the term
metrics.def: Renewal options used and left
metrics.threshold: No option left: goes to bid

metrics.name: Termination for convenience
metrics.def: Whether the client can end the agreement without cause, and the notice

metrics.name: Strategic and reference value
metrics.def: How often the contract is named in our own proposals
